## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [DBL Array Terminal](other_terminals/double_precision.md) | Creates a double-precision array control and its linked diagram terminal. |
| [Integer Array Terminal](other_terminals/integer.md) | Palette icon for an array of signed 32-bit integers. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Boolean Array Terminal](other_terminals/boolean.md) | Palette icon for an array of Booleans. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [String Array Terminal](other_terminals/string.md) | Palette icon for an array of strings. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Waveform Array Terminal](other_terminals/waveform.md) | Palette icon for an array of waveforms. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Timestamp Array Terminal](other_terminals/timestamp.md) | Places a Front Panel array with dedicated Time Stamp elements and a linked diagram terminal. Controls provide a date/time editor in UTC; indicators display time and date without numeric step buttons. |
| [Path Array Terminal](other_terminals/path.md) | Palette icon for an array of paths. Placement is not implemented yet. |
| [Cluster Array Terminal](other_terminals/cluster.md) | Creates an array of clusters and its linked diagram terminal. |
| [Error Array Terminal](other_terminals/error.md) | Palette icon for an array of errors. Placement is not implemented yet. |
